One license per category (color legend)

Eleven inline scripts below, each SPDX-tagged with a license from a different classify() category (src/background/license-db.js), so every color the popup can actually produce shows up at once in its per-script list. Open the popup on this page and compare each row's swatch against the legend table here (colors are copied from src/data/license-type-info.json, which is generated from the license-types package — see that file if this legend ever looks stale).

CategoryColorScript below
missing lightgray (no tag)
uncategorized darkgray LicenseRef-Example-Custom
unlicensed black UNLICENSED
custom gray SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE.txt
publicDomain darkgreen CC0-1.0
permissive green MIT
weaklyProtective #CCCC00 LGPL-3.0
protective pink GPL-3.0
networkProtective #FF69B4 AGPL-3.0
useProtective red CC-BY-NC-4.0
modifyProtective red CC-BY-ND-4.0

All eleven categories in license-type-info.json are covered above. unlicensed and custom aren't reachable from a real SPDX id — classify() special-cases the literal UNLICENSED and SEE LICENSE IN ... strings for them, mirroring npm's own package.json "license" field conventions (see the license-types package README) rather than anything from the actual SPDX license list.
